recognize_zh: 淋巴結左下為小淋巴球區，右上則由成巢、細胞質淡粉紅的多角形上皮細胞取代皮質並延伸到被膜，右下可見被膜外脂肪組織，屬於轉移性乳管癌侵犯腋下淋巴結。
features: Nests and sheets of polygonal epithelial cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm in the upper right cortex
Enlarged pleomorphic nuclei with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli
Tumor extends toward and into the fibrous capsule
Residual dense small-lymphocyte area at the lower left
Perinodal adipose tissue at the lower right; scattered pigment-laden macrophages at left
describe_en: Section of lymph node shows residual lymphoid tissue in the lower left and an infiltrate of cohesive nests and sheets of polygonal epithelial cells occupying the cortex in the upper right. The tumor cells have pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and enlarged pleomorphic nuclei with nucleoli, and the infiltrate extends to the fibrous capsule adjacent to perinodal adipose tissue. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with metastatic ductal carcinoma of the breast; assessment for extranodal extension is warranted.

ddx.vs: Histiocytes fill sinuses with bland oval nuclei and foamy cytoplasm and are CD68/CD163 positive, cytokeratin negative.
Lobular carcinoma infiltrates as discohesive single cells or single files that mimic histiocytes and lacks E-cadherin, rather than cohesive nests.
Melanoma forms sheets of epithelioid cells with prominent nucleoli that are S100/SOX10/Melan-A positive and cytokeratin negative.

ddx.dx: Benign epithelial inclusions / ectopic breast tissue
ddx.vs: Benign inclusions form bland ducts with a preserved myoepithelial layer (p63, SMMHC) rather than atypical solid nests.
